//: The PingAM script program. Separate from the endpoint program because AM and IDM declare colliding globals — both have a `logger`, and they are different shapes. `lib` is shared with the endpoint program because both run on essentially the same Rhino build: 765 probes each on a running stack, differing only on `Math`/`JSON` `Symbol.toStringTag`, which neither program can reach. That sharing is sound because each program is checked against ITS OWN engine, not because the engines are the same object. framework/engine-surface.json is the data and framework/engine-coverage.json is what it covers. tests/engine-lib.test.mjs fails if the pin promises something unprobed; `fo build` fails if any source USES a builtin the engine lacks — 234 of the 728 the lib declares are absent on PingAM and cannot be removed from it. Managed file — regenerated by `fo upgrade`.
